deck_title: Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy (CFL) adaptive substep guard vs naive supercritical upwind checkerboard blowup rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Richard Courant, Kurt Friedrichs & Hans Lewy (Mathematische Annalen 1928) adaptive substep / characteristic stencil guard (partitioning supercritical Courant numbers C = v * dt / dx = 1 + u in [1.0000, 2.0000] into N_sub = ceil(C) substeps with C_sub = C / N_sub <= 1.0, locking the spectral amplification ceiling |G|_max = 1.0000x across all 17 stations with 0/17 violated stations) versus naive single-step explicit upwind advection (which violates the CFL domain-of-dependence condition when C = 1 + u > 1, amplifying the Nyquist checkerboard wavenumber k*dx = pi by |1 - 2C| = 1 + 2u per step to 1.5000x at C=1.25, 2.0000x at C=1.50, and 3.0000x / 9.00x wave energy at C=2.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-substep unitary characteristic phase propagation.
